feedback: 'The ground felt like it was wobbling like jelly, and then it stopped — the shaking does not go on forever; it settles.'
If a child seems worried: 'The shaking does not last forever, and the ground does not open up and swallow people.'
activities.intendedInsight: An earthquake is something people feel in their bodies; a weak one can be barely noticeable, and the shaking settles.
learnerActions: Listen to a friendly character describe feeling a small earthquake
Ask or choose questions like 'Was it scary?' and 'What did you do?'
Talk about what you would feel and do if the ground wobbled like jelly under your feet
activities.title: Someone who felt an earthquake
